candidate_locus_for_coverage_only.definition: unit-vector spherical midpoint of the frozen v075 endpoint detector coordinates a_ra_deg/a_dec_deg and b_ra_deg/b_dec_deg
candidate_locus_for_coverage_only.reason: The opportunity census only asks whether a comparison plate covers the already-registered common-sky locus. No recurrence separation is measured in v077.

eligible_independent_comparison_opportun: a parseable exact footprint from stc_polygon or header_wcs
candidate locus is interior or within the frozen 30 arcsec conservative edge margin
scan metadata are present for the selected covering solution

exact_coverage.edge_margin_role: conservative opportunity preservation only; it is not a recurrence association radius
footprint_preference: official header_wcs + exact scan naxis1/naxis2 footprint
exact_coverage.unusable_footprint: GEOMETRY_UNRESOLVED; preserved, not silently counted as non-coverage

interpretation_boundaries.next_stage: freeze acquisition and sensitivity-qualified recurrence/injection-recovery against the v077 eligible opportunity universe

official_metadata_transport.overflow_policy: STOP_OPERATIONALLY; never interpret partial TAP rows as a complete opportunity census

purpose: Prospectively freeze a complete metadata-only census of solved APPLAUSE DR4 physical plates that could provide independent comparison coverage for the full pair-17 registered population, before any comparison pixels, recurrence detections, or injection/recovery outcomes are inspected.

scope.archive_scope: all solved APPLAUSE DR4 plates; no date restriction

solution_superset_query.retrieval_geometry: RA/Dec rectangular superset enclosing the conservative spherical cap; exact coverage is decided locally from official solution footprints
solution_superset_query.target_cap: spherical mean of all 603 frozen coverage loci plus maximum angular distance from that mean to any locus

v077_outputs.candidate_plate_opportunities: one row per candidate x independent physical plate
v077_outputs.candidate_solution_coverage: all queried solution x candidate coverage evaluations
v077_outputs.plate_inventory: deduplicated physical plate metadata plus exposure/scan provenance
v077_outputs.summary: PRIMARY_424 / DIAGNOSTIC_179 opportunity counts and unresolved geometry counts
v077_outputs.tap_query_manifest: query text, SHA256, raw VOTable SHA256, row counts, overflow state
